correctness.rationale: The regular differential basis (dx/y, dx/y², xdx/y², dx/y³, xdx/y³, x²dx/y³) has six members from Riemann–Hurwitz. Coefficient-extraction Cartier matrix has triangular j=2 subblock with diagonal U=a³-b and V=3a, and a 1↔3 return scalar H. Stable semilinear ranks yield f7=2[H!=0]+[U!=0]+[V!=0], while instantaneous rank gives a=2+[UV=0]. Independently recomputed discriminant and ideal <H,H_a,H_b>=(a,b) mod7; H=0 has one ordinary node and irreducible projective quartic of genus-two normalization. F7 finite sample does not establish all algebraic closure parameters.
